lines.speaker: Barista
lines.text: Hi sir, welcome to Common Grounds. What can I get for you today?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Hello. I want... two lattes, please. One with oat milk.

lines.speaker: Barista
lines.text: Sure. Hot or iced for the second one?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I am not sure... sorry, can you say that again, please?

lines.speaker: Barista
lines.text: No problem. Hot or iced? Cold or warm?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Iced, please. And... medium size. Thank you.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: أَهْلًا بِيكُمْ يا جَمَاعَة فِي يَلَّا فْلُوِنْت! أَنَا مَحْمُود، وَالنَّهَارْدَه مَعَاكُمْ فِي مَقْهَى كُومِن جْرَاوْنْدْ...

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: مَاكَال بِيِطْلُبْ قَهْوَة لِنُور، وَبِيلَاقِي نَفْسُه مُحْتَاجْ يِسْأَلْ وَيِوَضِّحْ... وَدِي أَوَّلْ مُحَاوَلَة حَقِيقِيَّة لِلتَّوَاصُلْ!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: رَكِّزُوا مَعَايَا عَلَى تَلَاتَة تَعْبِيرَات: طَلَبْ مُؤَدَّبْ زَي "I'd like..."، وَسُؤَالْ عَنْ التَّفْضِيلْ زَي "Do you prefer..."، وَطَلَبْ التَّوْضِيحْ زَي "Could you say that again?"
lines.direction: clear, teaching, slow on the phrases

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلَّا بِيْنَا نِسْمَعْ، وَمَتْخَافُوش مِنَ الغَلَطْ... الغَلَطْ هُوَ الطَّرِيقْ لِلتَّقَدُّمْ!

lines.speaker: Barista
lines.text: Two lattes — one oat milk, one iced, both medium. Anything else?
lines.direction: brisk, friendly, calling back the order

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: No, that is all. Wait... actually, can I change the first one? I would like it hot, please.

lines.speaker: Barista
lines.text: Of course. Hot oat latte and iced latte. Give me two minutes.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: You remembered my oat milk. I am impressed.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Of course. You always take it that way... I think.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Every single morning. Okay — since you are buying, what do you prefer? Coffee or tea, I mean.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Honestly, I prefer tea. But I order coffee to... how do you say... to fit in?

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Wait, really? You drink coffee just to fit in? That is a lot of effort.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I know. I copy how people talk here. I speak like the British men in my office. I do not know why.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Because that is what you hear every day. But Macal — you do not need to sound like them.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Maybe. But sometimes I feel my English is not good enough. I live here since two years and I still...

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Hey. Two years and you are ordering coffee for me in a busy shop, no panic. That is good enough. Trust me.

lines.speaker: Barista
lines.text: Two lattes ready! Hot oat, iced. Enjoy.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Thank you. And... thank you, Nour. Really.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: طَيِّبْ يا جَمَاعَة، تَعَالُوا نْشُوفْ أَحْلَى تَلَاتَة تَعْبِيرَاتْ مِنَ المَشْهَدْ دَه...

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: أَوَّلْ وَاحِدَة: I'd like... وْمَعْنَاهَا عَايِزْ أَوْ نَفْسِي فِي حَاجَة، وْبِنِسْتَخْدِمْهَا لَمَّا نِطْلُبْ بِأَدَبْ... زَي مَا مَاكَال قَالْ: I'd like it hot, please.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: تَانِي وَاحِدَة: Do you prefer... وْمَعْنَاهَا بِتَفَضِّلْ إِيهْ؟ وْبِنِسْأَلْ بِيهَا عَنِ الاخْتِيَارَاتْ... زَي: Do you prefer coffee or tea?

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: تَالْت وَاحِدَة: Could you say that again? وْمَعْنَاهَا تِقْدَرْ تِقُولْ تَانِي؟ وْبِنِسْتَخْدِمْهَا لَمَّا مِشْ سَامْعِينْ كْوَيِّسْ أَوْ مِحْتَاجِينْ تَوْضِيحْ... زَي لَمَّا البَارِيسْتَا تِتْكَلِّمْ بِسُرْعَة.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وْدِلْوَقْتِي الغَلْطَة المَشْهُورَة... مَاكَال قَالْ: I live here since two years. دِي غَلْطَة بِنْعْمِلْهَا كُلِّنَا!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: لِيهْ بِنْغَلَطْ؟ عَشَانْ فِي العَرَبِي بِنْقُولْ "مِنْ سَنِتَيْن" وْنِفَكِّرْ إِنْ since مَعْنَاهَا مِنْ... لَكِنْ فِي الإِنْجِلِيزِي since بْتِيجِي مَعَ الـ present perfect.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: الصَّحْ: I've lived here for two years. أَوْ: I've been here for two years. خَلِّي بَالَكْ: for مَعَ المُدَّة، وْsince مَعَ البِدَايَة.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وْآخِرْ حَاجَة... مَاكَال بِيِقَلِّدْ الإِنْجِلِيزِي البِرِيطَانِي عَشَانْ زُمَلَاهْ بِيِتْكَلْمُوا كِدَه. وْدِي طَبِيعِي! لَكِنْ نُور عَنْدَهَا حَقّ... مِشْ لَازِمْ تِبْقَى زَي حَدْ تَانِي. إِنْتَ إِنْتَ.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلَّا، نِسْمَعْ الحِوَارْ تَانِي وْنِشُوفْ إِزَّايْ مَاكَال هِيِكَمِّلْ...

lines.speaker: Barista
lines.text: Excuse me — you forgot your change. And here, a small cookie. For the tall one who always says thank you.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Oh! Thank you. I did not expect that. Nour, this is for you. I know you like sweet things.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Look at you. Do you prefer chocolate or the plain one?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I prefer... hmm. I have lived in Dubai for two years, so I choose both.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Both? That is a very Dubai answer. Okay, I respect it.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Wait — I said that right? For two years? With for? Yes. Finally.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: You said it perfectly. See? You do not need to sound like anyone else. Just sound like Macal.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Okay. Then... could you say that again? I want to remember it.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: I said, just sound like Macal. Oh — and one more thing. I am from Michigan, not London.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: What? Michigan? But your English sounds so... American. Wait, that is the point, yes?

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Exactly the point. Anyway — Tarek just posted something. Look.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: "Rising Voices — my first week." He already made a video? It looks so... professional.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Do not watch it now. Coffee first. But Macal... maybe you should think about your own video.
lines.direction: gentle, encouraging, hinting at what's next

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: طَيِّبْ يَا جَمَاعَة... نِلَخِّصْ بِسُرْعَة. عَشَانْ تِقُولْ مُدَّة،، اسْتَخْدِمْ for،، زَي: I have lived here for two years. وْعَشَانْ تِقُولْ البِدَايَة،، اسْتَخْدِمْ since،، زَي: I have lived here since 2022.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وْعِبَارَة الحَلْقَة النَّهَارْدَة... Just sound like Macal. مِشْ لَازِمْ تِبْقَى زَي حَدْ،، إِنْتَ إِنْتَ!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وْطَبْعاً،، فِيهْ تِفَاصِيلْ صَغِيرَة بِنِسْتَخْدِمْهَا كَتِير،، زَي: I prefer،، وْcould you say that again. جَرِّبْهَا النَّهَارْدَة مَعَ حَدْ.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: لَوْ عَجَبَكْ،، اشْتَرِكْ فِي البُودْكَاسْت،، وْانْضَمْ لِنَا عَلَى التِّلِيجْرَام. اكْتُبْ لِي: إِنْتَ مِصْرِي وْلا مِنِين؟ وْاسْمَعْ المَشْهَدْ مَرَّة تَانْيَة.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وْالحَلْقَة الجَايَة... مَاكَال هَيِقَرَّرْ يِعْمِلْ الفِيدْيُو بْتِعُه. لَكِنْ فِيهْ سُؤَال: هَلْ هَيِلْحَقْ تَارِك؟ يَلَّا،، بَاكِرْ!
